facts.fact: Ethio Telecom, Djibouti Telecom and Sudatel Group signed a strategic agreement under the Horizon Fiber Initiative, 'last week' relative to the 2026-02-11 article, to build a cross-border terrestrial fibre corridor linking Djibouti's submarine cable landing stations via Ethiopia to Sudan's landing stations.
The February 2026 agreement builds on a memorandum of understanding the three telcos signed in Ethiopia in December 2024 on establishing a secure alternative international route.

systems.owner: Ethio Telecom, Djibouti Telecom, Sudatel Group
